title: Concurrent Master Order Placement During Sub-Account Deposit Storm
precondition: 50 investors depositing simultaneously while master executes 3 rapid orders.
steps: 1. Fire parallel deposits and trade orders.
expected_result: ACID transaction isolation prevents race conditions; each trade sized on clean committed balance snapshot.
actual_result: ACID isolation prevents race conditions: Orders are sized on clean committed snapshots while deposits execute concurrently.
